input.title: Has My Replacement Card Been Sent?
input.request: I need to know whether the replacement card ordered for my H&V account has actually been dispatched. The secure portal confirmed that my request was accepted, but I cannot see confirmation of delivery or dispatch.

events.text: Your replacement card request has been accepted. This confirms the request was received; it does not confirm dispatch or delivery.
I’m following up because the portal only says my replacement card request was accepted. Please check whether dispatch has been registered; I don’t have confirmation that the card has arrived.
I’m checking the card journal for the dispatch record associated with case HV-021. The customer has asked whether dispatch was registered; please return the recorded status only.

summary: Mara Ellison, a customer on secure chat whose identity is not verified, asked the desk to check whether dispatch of her replacement card had been registered. The desk classified this as a card question and marked the card system as asked, but no answer from it is in the record. The case closed in a waiting state, and a second attempt to ask the card system was refused because the case was already waiting. No dispatch status was found, so nothing can be said about whether the card has been sent; a person is left to pick the case up.

request_type.instructions: What does the customer want from the bank now?

criteria.question: something the bank's records can answer (a status, a reason, a detail, a statement, a report), even if the customer may want something changed afterwards
criteria.register: a dispute, a review, a return, or the correction of a record that is wrong, for a team to look into
criteria.change: a change the customer chooses to an instruction, a mandate or the profile (a new amount, date, phone or address)
criteria.instruction: an instruction to act now (block a card, cancel a payment or a mandate, revoke a role)
criteria.access: signing in, a PIN, a password, recovery of access
criteria.authority: something only another person may approve or give (a second signatory, an administrator, a new user's access)
criteria.other: none of these (a bereavement, a complaint, a request for the personal data the bank holds, closing an account, credit)
criteria.unknown: The text does not say, or says too little to tell.

criteria.transfer: an outgoing transfer or payment the customer made, or a payment instruction
criteria.incoming_payment: money expected into the customer's account, or a refund to it
criteria.standing_order: a standing order or a recurring payment instruction
criteria.direct_debit: a Direct Debit mandate or collection
criteria.card: a card itself (replacement, dispatch, block, restriction, PIN)
criteria.card_payment: a card purchase or card payment attempt
criteria.batch: an uploaded payment or payroll file, or a row in it
criteria.payment_package: a payment package waiting for signatories
criteria.profile: the customer's profile details (name, phone, address)
criteria.access: signing in, devices, sessions, password recovery
criteria.document: an export, a report or a bank confirmation document
criteria.fee: a fee or charge applied by the bank
criteria.role: a user's role or access in a company profile
criteria.unknown: The text does not say, or says too little to tell.

I haven't been able to check whether your replacement card has been dispatched, and I'm stopping here. The card system refused my lookup because the case is in a waiting state and the card system has already been marked as asked. The case record holds no dispatch information, so I can't say what the status is.

The only confirmation on file is the portal's message that your request was accepted. That message says nothing about dispatch or delivery, and I'm not claiming more than it shows.

Your identity is also not yet verified on this chat. The case stays open in the waiting state, and a person will pick it up from there.
